Being prepared for anything is easier than ever these days. You don’t need a huge diesel generator to make sure you can keep things running when the power goes out; for example, with products like the Bluetti AC200L portable power station using batteries instead. And you can pick that very power station up today for just $798.99.

This portable power station would usually retail for around $1,109.99, a full $300 more than the current discount price. That’s a deal that’s available to everyone right now – no discount codes, no coupons. You don’t even need to be an Amazon Prime member, as is the case with some deals.

The catch? This is listed as a limited-time deal, and we don’t know for sure when it will end. Delaying your order does risk missing out and paying more than you had to, so we would absolutely recommend taking advantage of this deal sooner rather than later.

The Bluetti AC200L portable power station has a 2,048Wh battery capacity, which can be upgraded to 8,192Wh if you need extra breathing space. The power station can also be powered by a solar panel if you want to go that route.

This power station is a great option for those who like to be prepared or who enjoy the outdoor life but still like to have power on hand for life’s creature comforts.

Buy: Bluetti AC200L Portable Power Station: $798.99  | Original price: $1,099
